description.value:
This system destabilizes enemy mech machinery with electromagnetic pulses.

@PPAbility[cost:3]{Jam Weapon} Disable an enemy mech's weapon for 1 minute.

@PPAbility[cost:4]{Kill Engine} Reduce an enemy mech's movement speed to 0 for 1 round.

@PPAbility[cost:3]{Sabotage Power} Prevent an enemy mech from expending power points for 1 round.

Save DC: 12 + half mech tier.
